notes: BeyondArena mice_protein_trisomy_discriminant (Purucker et al. 2026, arXiv 2606.30410), from UCI 342 Mice Protein Expression (Higuera et al. 2015, PLoS ONE e0129126), a subset of Ahmed et al. 2015 (PLoS ONE e0119491): 77 proteins of the cortex nuclear fraction in 72 mice, 15 measurements per protein and mouse (three replicates of a five-point dilution series). The curation drops Genotype, Treatment and Behavior, which class combines into eight groups, and the duplicate pS6_N. Ahmed et al. fit each protein by a three-level mixed model with mouse as the random effect and compare the eight groups; replicate and dilution are held by no column, so the formula keeps the mouse level. class is constant within each mouse, the proteins vary within it. The 73 proteins beyond the third are in ignore. Hand check #162 batch 4: filed out as one label per group, found grouped by its proteins.
